caption: The drawing depicts two corset designs on a plain, light beige background. Both corsets are illustrated in a grey pencil, with detailed decorative patterns drawn on the fabric surfaces. The larger corset, positioned on the right side of the image, is shown from the front and features off-the-shoulder straps adorned with small ruffles, intricate floral and scrollwork details, and vertical panel lines. The smaller corset, located in the upper left quadrant, is depicted from the back and displays similar ruffled edges along the neckline and shoulders, vertical seam lines, and a central row of laces for fastening. Both corsets have a fitted waist and hourglass shape, and the lines are fine and precise, revealing the structure and embellishments of the garments. The background is unadorned, and there is no shading or color besides the pencil lines and the natural paper tone.
title: Corset
